name: LightGaussian
definition: A method that prunes Gaussians with a smaller importance score and adopts octree-based lossless compression in G-PCC for the position attribute.
summary: LightGaussian is a 3D Gaussian Splatting compression method that achieves up to 15x size reduction and over 200 FPS by combining structured pruning with Spherical Harmonic factorization and vector quantization.
